Houston, TX · Hair and makeup artists

Blush and Company

$250 person

Southwest Houston makeup and hair studio for bridal, commercial, and fashion clients, with separate in-studio and on-location wedding rates.

In-studio hair and makeup is $250 total ($130 makeup and $120 hair). Trials are $250 total, Monday through Thursday only. On location, the first person is $350 total ($180 makeup and $170 hair), and each additional person is $250. Extra travel is $2 per mile round trip. · Source · checked 2026-10-03 · published

7601 W. Sam Houston Pkwy S, Suite 150, Houston, TX 77072
